insights.summary: Q1 FY27 revenue jumped 56% to a record ₹308 Cr (volumes +42%), the EBITDA margin rose to 24.2% from 17% and PAT was ₹36 Cr, as new industrial chemicals with better margins ramped up and utilisation reached ~65%. Management raised the FY28 revenue target to over ₹1,600 Cr, targets 30-40% annual growth for the next few years, expects to hold Q1's margin through FY27, and doubled FY27 capex to ₹250 Cr for two new buildings (part funded by ~₹100 Cr of new debt). Net debt/EBITDA fell to 1.86x and working capital to 143 days; credit ratings were upgraded to A-.

FY27 capex doubled to ₹250 Cr; ~₹100 Cr new borrowing
30-40% annual revenue growth over the next few years
MNC contract commercial in Q1 FY28

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: Number two, we do have some commitment from our marquee customers, which is helping us to confidence to give the guidance that we will be able to maintain in the coming quarters also the similar EBITDA margins.

analyst_questions.answer: Higher utilisation (50% to 65%), new products with ~10-12 points better margins, customer commitments; not inventory gains.
Formula-based quarterly pricing keeps EBITDA percentage, not per-kg, constant.
~2.5x asset turn; 60-65% of new capacity already committed by customers.
Genuine raw-material shortages and container booking delays; inventory fell partly for that reason.

red_flags.text: Margin jump to 24% from a historic 17-18% after a single quarter, with price increases of 10-15% in April.
Lower inventory partly because raw materials did not arrive, not only better management.
New debt of ~₹100 Cr soon after deleveraging; capex doubled.
Management declines to give plant-level utilisation or capacity.
